analog_lever.title: Controlling signals using the Analog Lever
messages: Analog Levers make for a compact and precise source of redstone power
Right-click to increase its analog power output
Right-click while Sneaking to decrease the power output again

andesite_tunnel.title: Using Andesite Tunnels
messages: Andesite Tunnels can be used to cover up your belts
Whenever an Andesite Tunnel has connections to the sides...
...they will split exactly one item off of any passing stacks
The remainder will continue on its path

auto_schedule.title: Stations & Scheduling
messages: Schedules can be used to provide drivers with a destination
Comparators will receive a signal whenever a Train is present
Mind that a Station can only be approached from the indicated direction
Stations can also be used to assign new Schedules automatically
The Schedule placed on a station will automatically copy itself to present trains
As opposed to manual scheduling, drivers will not take the item with them

basin.title: Processing Items in the Basin
messages: A Basin can hold Items and Fluids for Processing
After a processing step, basins try to output below to the side of them
When a valid component is present, the Basin will show an output faucet
A number of options are applicable here
Outputs will be caught by the inventory below
Without output faucet, the Basin will retain items created in its processing
This can be useful if outputs should be re-used as ingredients
Desired outputs will then have to be extracted from the basin
A Filter might be necessary to avoid pulling out un-processed items

bearing_modes.title: Movement Modes of the Mechanical Bearing
messages: When Stopped, the Bearing will place the structure at the nearest grid-aligned Angle
It can be configured never to revert to solid blocks, or only near the angle it started at

belt_casing.title: Encasing Belts
messages: Brass or Andesite Casing can be used to decorate Mechanical Belts
A wrench can be used to remove the casing

belt_connector.title: Using Mechanical Belts
messages: Right-Clicking two shafts with a belt item will connect them together
Accidental selections can be canceled with Right-Click while Sneaking
Additional Shafts can be added throughout the Belt
Shafts connected via Belts will rotate with Identical Speed and Direction
Added shafts can be removed using the wrench
Mechanical Belts can be dyed for aesthetic purposes

belt_directions.title: Valid Orientations for Mechanical Belts
messages: Belts cannot connect in arbitrary directions
1. They can connect horizontally
2. They can connect diagonally
3. They can connect vertically
4. And they can connect vertical shafts horizontally
These are all possible directions. Belts can span any Length between 2 and 20 blocks

belt_transport.title: Using Mechanical Belts for Logistics
messages: Moving belts will transport Items and other Entities
Right-Click with an empty hand to take items off a belt

blaze_burner.title: Feeding Blaze Burners
messages: Blaze Burners can provide Heat to Items processed in a Basin
For this, the Blaze has to be fed with flammable items
With a Blaze Cake, the Burner can reach an even stronger level of heat
The feeding process can be automated using Deployers or Mechanical Arms

brass_funnel.title: The Brass Funnel
messages: Andesite Funnels can only ever extract single items.
Brass Funnels can extract up to a full stack.
The value panel allows for precise control over the extracted stack size.
Using items on the filter slot will restrict the funnel to only transfer matching stacks.

brass_tunnel.title: Using Brass Tunnels
messages: Brass Tunnels can be used to cover up your belts
Brass Tunnels have filter slots on each open side
Filters on inbound connections simply block non-matching items
Filters on outbound connections can be used to sort items by type
Whenever a passing item has multiple valid exits, the distribution mode will decide how to handle it
Brass Tunnels on parallel belts will form a group
Incoming Items will now be distributed across all connected exits
For this, items can also be inserted into the Tunnel block directly

brass_tunnel_modes.title: Distribution Modes of the Brass Tunnel
messages: The distribution behaviour of Brass Tunnels can be configured
'Split' will attempt to distribute the stack evenly between available outputs
If an output is unable to take more items, it will be skipped
'Forced Split' will never skip outputs, and instead wait until they are free
'Round Robin' keeps stacks whole, and cycles through outputs iteratively
Once Again, if an output is unable to take more items, it will be skipped
'Forced Round Robin' never skips outputs
'Prefer Nearest' prioritizes the outputs closest to the items' input location
'Randomize' will distribute whole stacks to randomly picked outputs
'Synchronize Inputs' is a unique setting for Brass Tunnels
Items are only allowed past if every tunnel in the group has one waiting
This ensures that all affected belts supply items at the same rate

cart_assembler.title: Moving Structures using Cart Assemblers
messages: Powered Cart Assemblers mount attached structures to passing Minecarts
Without a redstone signal, it disassembles passing cart contraptions back into blocks
Using a Wrench on the Minecart will let you carry the Contraption elsewhere

cart_assembler_dual.title: Assembling Carriage Contraptions
messages: Whenever two Cart Assemblers share an attached structure...
Powering either of them will create a Carriage Contraption
The carts will behave like those connected via Minecart Coupling

cart_assembler_modes.title: Orientation Settings for Minecart Contraptions
messages: Cart Contraptions will rotate to face towards their carts' motion
This Arrow indicates which side of the Structure will be considered the front
If the Assembler is set to Lock Rotation, the contraptions' orientation will never change

cart_assembler_rails.title: Other types of Minecarts and Rails
messages: Cart Assemblers on Regular Tracks will not affect the passing carts' motion
When on Powered or Controller Rail, the carts will be held in place until it's Powered
Other types of Minecarts can be used as the anchor
Furnace Carts will keep themselves powered, pulling fuel from any attached inventories

chain_conveyor.title: Relaying rotational force using Chain Conveyors
messages: Right-click two conveyors with chains to connect them
Chain conveyors relay rotational power between each other..
..and connect to shafts above or below them
Right-click holding a wrench to start travelling on the chain
At a junction, face towards a chain to follow it

chain_drive.title: Relaying rotational force with Chain Drives
messages: Chain Drives relay rotation to each other in a row
All shafts connected like this will rotate in the same direction
Any part of the row can be rotated by 90 degrees

chain_gearshift.title: Controlling rotational speed with Chain Gearshifts
messages: Unpowered Chain Gearshifts behave exactly like Chain Drives
When Powered, the speed transmitted to other Chain Drives in the row is doubled
Whenever the Powered Gearshift is not at the source, its speed will be halved instead
In both cases, Chain Drives in the row always run at 2x the speed of the Powered Gearshift
Using analog signals, the ratio can be adjusted more precisely between 1 and 2
12 RPM

chute.title: Transporting Items downward via Chutes
messages: Chutes can transport items vertically from and to inventories
Using the Wrench, a window can be created
Using Industrial Iron Blocks, chutes can be encased
Placing chutes targeting the side faces of another will make it diagonal

chute_upward.title: Transporting Items upward via Chutes
messages: Using Encased Fans at the top or bottom, a Chute can move items upward
Inspecting chutes with Engineers' Goggles reveals information about the movement direction
On the 'blocked' end, items will have to be inserted/taken from the sides

clockwork_bearing.title: Animating Structures using Clockwork Bearings
messages: Clockwork Bearings attach to blocks in front of them
Upon receiving Rotational Force, the structure will be rotated according to the hour of the day
Right-Click the bearing to start or stop animating the structure
In front of the Hour Hand, a second structure can be added
Ensure that the two Structures are not glued to each other
The Second Structure will now rotate as the Minute Hand

clutch.title: Controlling rotational force using a Clutch
messages: Clutches will relay rotation in a straight line
When powered by Redstone, it breaks the connection

cog_speedup.title: Gearshifting with Cogs
messages: Large and Small cogs can be connected diagonally
Shifting from large to small cogs, the conveyed speed will be doubled
Shifting the opposite way, the conveyed speed will be halved

cogwheel.title: Relaying rotational force using Cogwheels
messages: Cogwheels will relay rotation to other adjacent cogwheels
Neighbouring shafts connected like this will rotate in opposite directions

cogwheel_casing.title: Encasing Cogwheels
messages: Brass or Andesite Casing can be used to decorate Cogwheels
Components added after encasing will not connect to the shaft outputs
The Wrench can be used to toggle connections

contraption_controls.title: Using Contraption Controls
messages: Actors on moving contraptions are always active by default
Contraption Controls can be used to toggle them on the fly
They can be attached anywhere on the contraption
While disassembled, the filter can be changed to target specific types of actors
If it is redstone-activated during assembly...
...targeted actors will be turned off from the start

creative_fluid_tank.title: Creative Fluid Tanks
messages: Creative Fluid Tanks can be used to provide a bottomless supply of fluid
Right-Click with a fluid containing item to configure it
Pipe Networks can now endlessly draw the assigned fluid from the tank
Any Fluids pushed back into a Creative Fluid Tank will be voided

creative_motor.title: Generating Rotational Force using Creative Motors
messages: Creative motors are a compact and configurable source of Rotational Force
The generated speed can be configured on its input panels

crushing_wheels.title: Processing Items with Crushing Wheels
messages: A pair of Crushing Wheels can grind items very effectively
Their Rotational Input has to make them spin into each other
Items thrown or inserted into the top will get processed
Items can be inserted and picked up through automated means as well

deployer.title: Using the Deployer
messages: Given Rotational Force, a Deployer can imitate player interactions
It will always interact with the position 2 blocks in front of itself
Blocks directly in front will not obstruct it
Deployers can:
Place Blocks,
Use Items,
Activate Blocks,
Harvest blocks
and Attack Mobs
Right-click the front to give it an Item to use
Items can also be inserted automatically
Deployers carry a filter slot
When a filter is set, it activates only while holding a matching item
Only items matching the filter can now be inserted...
...and only non-matching items will be extracted

deployer_contraption.title: Using Deployers on Contraptions
messages: Whenever Deployers are moved as part of an animated Contraption...
They activate at each visited location, using items from inventories anywhere on the contraption
The Filter slot can be used to specify which items to pull

deployer_modes.title: Modes of the Deployer
messages: By default, a Deployer imitates a Right-click interaction
Using a Wrench, it can be set to imitate a Left-click instead

deployer_processing.title: Processing Items using Deployers
messages: With a fitting held item, Deployers can process items provided beneath them
The Input items can be dropped or placed on a Depot under the Deployer
When items are provided on a belt...
The Deployer will hold and process them automatically

deployer_redstone.title: Controlling Deployers with Redstone
messages: When powered by Redstone, Deployers will not activate
Before stopping, the Deployer will finish any started cycles
Thus, a negative pulse can be used to trigger exactly one activation cycle

depot.title: Using Depots
messages: Depots can serve as 'stationary' belt elements
Right-Click to manually place or remove Items from it
Just like Mechanical Belts, it can provide items to processing
...as well as provide Items to Mechanical Arms

display_board.title: Using Display Boards
messages: Display Boards are a scalable alternative to the sign
They require Rotational Force to operate
Static text can be applied using written Clipboards
And dynamic text through the use of Display Links
Dyes can be applied to individual lines of the board
Lines can be reset by clicking them with an empty hand

display_link.title: Setting up Display Links
messages: Display Links can be used to visualise dynamic information
First, right-click the target display...
...then attach it to the block to read from
Open the Interface to select and configure what is sent
The display will now receive information from the link
Not every block can act as a source
Each compatible block provides unique information
The Display Link can work with several different displays

display_link_redstone.title: Redstone Control
messages: When powered by Redstone, Display Links stop sending updates
Once unpowered, the Timer is reset and new info is sent immediately
Signals emitted from the source do not affect the Link

elevator_pulley.title: Using the Elevator Pulley
messages: Elevator Pulleys can move structures vertically between marked locations
Start by constructing a cabin
Place a pair of Redstone Contacts facing each other...
...and glue one of them to your moving structure
Contraption Controls can be attached to make floor selection easier
Ensure that the pulley is supplied with Rotational Power
Right-Clicking the pulley assembles the elevator
The stationary contact now turns into an Elevator Contact
Elevator Contacts represent a 'floor' and can be configured
Any redstone contact sharing this column will be converted
Supply a redstone pulse to call the elevator to the contact
The movement speed depends on the rotation input on the pulley
Scroll and click on the controls block to choose a floor while on-board
Right-Clicking the assembled pulley will turn the cabin back into blocks
Sliding doors attached to the cabin will open and close automatically
Elevator Contacts emit a signal while the cabin is on their floor
This can be useful to trigger doors or special effects upon arrival
Display Links on any of the contacts can show the current floor of the elevator

elevator_pulley_multi_rope.title: Synchronised Pulley Movement
messages: Whenever a pulley assembles a contraption...
...other pulleys on the same layer will connect to the structure
They do not require to be powered, the effect is purely cosmetic

empty_blaze_burner.title: Using Empty Blaze Burners
messages: Right-click a Blaze with the empty burner to capture it
Alternatively, Blazes can be collected from their Spawners directly
You now have an ideal heat source for various machines
For Aesthetic purposes, Empty Blaze Burners can also be lit using Flint and Steel
The flame can be transformed using a soul-infused item
However, without a blaze they are not suitable for industrial heating

encased_fluid_pipe.title: Encasing Fluid Pipes
messages: Copper Casing can be used to decorate Fluid Pipes
Aside from being concealed, Encased Pipes are locked into their connectivity state
It will no longer react to any neighbouring blocks being added or removed

factory_gauge_crafting.title: Automatic Crafting with Factory Gauges
messages: Factory gauges provide auto-arrangement for crafting table recipes
Connect the required ingredients as before
When a valid recipe is detected, a new button appears in the UI
With auto-arrangement active, the boxes can be unwrapped into crafters directly
The setup must be 3x3 and the crafters have to be connected via wrench
Hold Right-click on the gauge to set the target amount
This crafter can now be used universally, by more gauges with different recipes
Outputs should be sent back to a linked inventory to close the loop
Using a Re-packager is recommended to prevent fragmentation of input packages

factory_gauge_links.title: Connecting Gauges to other Blocks
messages: When adding a new connection from the UI...
...the gauge also accepts Redstone and Display Links
Redstone links will be powered when the stock level is at or above the target amount
In receiver mode, links can stop the gauge from sending requests
Display links can provide a status overview of connected gauges

factory_gauge_recipe.title: Automated Recipes with Factory Gauges
messages: Whenever gauges are not placed on a packager...
They will instead monitor stock levels of all linked inventories
Right-click it with the item that should be monitored
It will now display the total amount present on the network
The gauge can replenish stock levels by sending other items to be processed
First, add the required ingredients as new factory gauges
From the target's UI, new connections can be made
For aesthetics, input panels can be wrenched to change the pathing
In the UI, review the inputs and specify how much of the output gets made per batch
Specify the address that ingredients should be sent to
The target amount to maintain can now be set by holding Right-click on the gauge
Whenever the network has fewer items than the amount...
...it will send new ingredients to the specified address
The outputs then need to return to any of the linked inventories
Green connections indicate that the target amount has been reached
The board of gauges can expand to include more recipe steps
Each gauge maintains the stock level of its item independently

factory_gauge_restocker.title: Restocking with Factory Gauges
messages: Right-click a Stock link before placement to connect to its network
When placed on a packager, factory gauges can monitor items inside the inventory
Right-click it with the item that should be monitored
It will now display the amount present in the inventory
The gauge can refill this inventory from the logistics network
Right-click it again to open its configuration UI
Set an address that should be used for the requested items
The target amount to maintain can now be set by holding Right-click on the gauge
Whenever the chest has fewer items than this amount...
...the logistics network sends more, with the specified address
From there, they can be routed to the packager

fan_direction.title: Air flow of Encased Fans
messages: Encased Fans use Rotational Force to create an Air Current
Strength and Direction of Flow depends on the Rotational Input

fan_processing.title: Processing Items using Encased Fans
messages: When passing through lava, the Air Flow becomes Heated
Items caught in the area will be smelted
Food items thrown here would be incinerated
Instead, a setup for Smoking using Fire should be used for them
Air Flows passing through water create a Washing Setup
Some interesting new processing can be done with it
The Speed of the Fan does NOT affect the processing speed, only its range
Fan Processing can also be applied to Items on Depots and Belts

fluid_pipe_flow.title: Moving Fluids using Copper Pipes
messages: Fluid Pipes can connect two or more fluid sources and targets
Using a wrench, a straight pipe segment can be given a window
Windowed pipes will not connect to any other adjacent pipe segments
Powered by Mechanical Pumps, the Pipes can transport Fluids
No fluid is being extracted at first
Once the flow connects them, the endpoints gradually transfer their contents
Thus, the Pipe blocks themselves never 'physically' contain any fluid

fluid_pipe_interaction.title: Draining and Filling fluid containers
messages: Endpoints of a pipe network can interact with a variety of blocks
Any block with fluid storage capabilities can be filled or drained
Source blocks right in front of an open end can be picked up...
...while spilling into empty spaces can create fluid sources
Pipes can also extract fluids from a handful of other blocks directly

fluid_tank_sizes.title: Dimensions of a Fluid tank
messages: Fluid Tanks can be combined to increase the total capacity
Their base square can be up to 3 blocks wide...
...and grow in height by more than 30 additional layers
Using a Wrench, a tanks' window can be toggled

fluid_tank_storage.title: Storing Fluids in Fluid Tanks
messages: Fluid Tanks can be used to store large amounts of fluid
Pipe networks can push and pull fluids from any side
The contained fluid can be measured by a Comparator
However, in Survival Mode Fluids cannot be added or taken manually
You can use Basins, Item Drains and Spouts to drain or fill fluid containing items

funnel_compat.title: Funnel compatibility
messages: Funnels should also interact nicely with a handful of other components.
Vertical Saws
Depots
Item Drains

funnel_direction.title: Direction of Transfer
messages: Placed normally, it pulls items from the inventory.
Placed while sneaking, it puts items into the inventory.
Using a wrench, the funnel can be flipped after placement.
Same rules will apply for most orientations.
Funnels on belts will extract/insert depending on its movement direction.

funnel_intro.title: Using funnels
messages: Funnels are ideal for transferring items from and to inventories.

funnel_redstone.title: Redstone control
messages: Redstone power will prevent any funnel from acting

funnel_transfer.title: Direct transfer
messages: Funnels cannot ever transfer between closed inventories directly.
Chutes or Smart chutes might be more suitable for such purposes.
Same applies for horizontal movement. A mechanical belt should help here.

gantry_cascaded.title: Cascaded Gantries
messages: Gantry shafts attach to a carriage without the need of super glue
Same applies for carriages on moved Gantry Shafts
Thus, a gantry system can be cascaded to cover multiple axes of movement

gantry_direction.title: Gantry Movement Direction
messages: Gantry Shafts can have opposite orientations
The movement direction of carriages depend on their shafts' orientation
...as well as the rotation direction of the shaft
Same rules apply for the propagated rotation

gantry_redstone.title: Gantry Power Propagation
messages: Redstone-powered gantry shafts stop moving their carriages
Instead, its rotational force is relayed to the carriages' output shaft

gearbox.title: Relaying rotational force using Gearboxes
messages: Jumping between axes of rotation can get bulky quickly
A gearbox is the more compact equivalent of this setup
Shafts around corners rotate in mirrored directions
Straight connections will be reversed

gearshift.title: Controlling rotational force using a Gearshift
messages: Gearshifts will relay rotation in a straight line
When powered by Redstone, it reverses the transmission

hand_crank.title: Generating Rotational Force using Hand Cranks
messages: Hand Cranks can be used by players to apply rotational force manually
Hold Right-Click to rotate it Counter-Clockwise
Sneak and Hold Right-Click to rotate it Clockwise

hose_pulley.title: Source Filling and Draining using Hose Pulleys
messages: Hose Pulleys can be used to fill or drain large bodies of Fluid
With the Kinetic Input, the height of the pulleys' hose can be controlled
The Pulley retracts while the input rotation is inverted
On the opposite side, pipes can be connected
Attached pipe networks can either provide fluid to the hose...
...or pull from it, draining the pool instead
Fill and Drain speed of the pulley depends entirely on the fluid networks' throughput

hose_pulley_infinite.title: Passively Filling and Draining large bodies of Fluid
messages: When deploying the Hose Pulley into a large enough ocean...
It will provide/dispose fluids without affecting the source
Pipe networks can limitlessly take fluids from/to such pulleys

hose_pulley_level.title: Fill and Drain level of Hose Pulleys
messages: While fully retracted, the Hose Pulley cannot operate
Draining runs from top to bottom
The surface level will end up just below where the hose ends
Filling runs from bottom to top
The filled pool will not grow beyond the layer above the hose end

item_drain.title: Emptying Fluid Containers using Item Drains
messages: Item Drains can extract fluids from items
Right-click it to pour fluids from your held item into it
When items are inserted from the side...
...they roll across, emptying out their contained fluid
Pipe Networks can now pull the fluid from the drains' internal buffer

item_vault_sizes.title: Dimensions of an Item Vault
messages: Item Vaults can be combined to increase the total capacity
Their base square can be up to 3 blocks wide...
...and grow in length up to 3x their diameter

item_vault_storage.title: Storing Items in Vaults
messages: Item Vaults can be used to store large amounts of items
However, contents cannot be added or taken manually
Any components for item transfer can both insert...
...and take contents from this container

large_cogwheel.title: Relaying rotational force using Large Cogwheels
messages: Large cogwheels can connect to each other at right angles
It will help relaying conveyed speed to other axes of rotation

large_water_wheel.title: Generating Rotational Force using Large Water Wheels
messages: Large Water Wheels draw force from adjacent Water Currents
Covering additional sides will not improve its kinetic output further
These rotate only at half the speed of regular water wheels...
...but provide a substantially higher stress capacity
Use wood planks on the wheel to change its appearance

linear_chassis_attachment.title: Attaching blocks using Linear Chassis
messages: The open faces of a Linear Chassis can be made Sticky
Click again to make the opposite side sticky
Sneak and Right-Click with an empty hand to remove the slime
Stickied faces of the Linear Chassis will attach a line of blocks in front of it
Using a Wrench, a precise Range can be specified for this chassis
Holding CTRL adjusts the range of all connected Chassis Blocks
Attaching blocks to any other side requires the use of Super Glue
Using these mechanics, structures of any shape can move as a Contraption

linear_chassis_group.title: Moving Linear Chassis in groups
messages: Linear Chassis connect to identical Chassis blocks next to them
When one is moved by a Contraption, the others are dragged with it
Chassis of a different type or facing another direction will not attach

mechanical_arm.title: Setting up Mechanical Arms
messages: Mechanical Arms have to be assigned their in- and outputs before they are placed
Right-Click inventories while holding the Arm to assign them as Targets
Right-Click again to toggle between Input (Blue) and Output (Yellow)
Left-Click components to remove their Selection
Once placed, the Mechanical Arm will target the blocks selected previously
They can have any amount of in- and outputs within their range
However, not every type of Inventory can be interacted with directly
Funnels and Depots can help to Bridge that gap

mechanical_arm_filtering.title: Filtering Outputs of the Mechanical Arm
messages: Inputs
Outputs
Sometimes it is desirable to restrict targets of the Arm by matching a filter
Mechanical Arms by themselves do not provide any options for filtering
Brass Funnels as Targets do however communicate their own filter to the Arm
The Arm is smart enough not to pick up items it couldn't distribute

mechanical_arm_modes.title: Distribution modes of the Mechanical Arm
messages: Input
Outputs
Whenever an Arm has to choose between multiple valid outputs...
...it will act according to its setting
The value panel will allow you to configure it
Round Robin mode simply cycles through all outputs that are available
If an output is unable to take more items, it will be skipped
Forced Round Robin mode will never skip outputs, and instead wait until they are free
Prefer First prioritizes the outputs selected earliest when configuring this Arm

mechanical_arm_redstone.title: Controlling Mechanical Arms with Redstone
messages: When powered by Redstone, Mechanical Arms will not activate
Before stopping, it will finish any started cycles
Thus, a negative pulse can be used to trigger exactly one activation cycle

mechanical_bearing.title: Moving Structures using the Mechanical Bearing
messages: Mechanical Bearings attach to the block in front of them
Upon receiving Rotational Force, it will assemble it into a Rotating Contraption

mechanical_crafter.title: Setting up Mechanical Crafters
messages: An array of Mechanical Crafters can be used to automate any Crafting Recipe
Using a Wrench, the Crafters' paths can be arranged
For a valid setup, all paths have to converge into one exit at any side
The outputs will be placed into the inventory at the exit
Mechanical Crafters require Rotational Force to operate
Right-Click the front to insert Items manually
Once every slot of a path contains an Item, the crafting process will begin
For recipes not fully occupying the crafter setup, the start can be forced using a Redstone Pulse

mechanical_crafter_connect.title: Connecting Inventories of Crafters
messages: Items can be inserted to Crafters automatically
Using the Wrench at their backs, Mechanical Crafter inputs can be combined
All connected Crafters can now be accessed by the same input location

mechanical_crafter_covers.title: Covering slots of Mechanical Crafters
messages: Some recipes will require additional Crafters to bridge gaps in the path
Using Slot Covers, Crafters can be set to act as an Empty Slot in the arrangement
Shared Inputs created with the Wrench at the back can also reach across covered Crafters

mechanical_drill.title: Breaking Blocks with the Mechanical Drill
messages: When given Rotational Force, a Mechanical Drill will break blocks directly in front of it
Its mining speed depends on the Rotational Input

mechanical_drill_contraption.title: Using Mechanical Drills on Contraptions
messages: Whenever Drills are moved as part of an animated Contraption...
...they will break blocks the contraption runs them into

mechanical_harvester.title: Using Mechanical Harvesters on Contraptions
messages: Whenever Harvesters are moved as part of an animated Contraption...
They will harvest and reset any mature crops on their way

mechanical_mixer.title: Processing Items with the Mechanical Mixer
messages: With a Mixer and Basin, some Crafting Recipes can be automated
Available recipes include any Shapeless Crafting Recipe, plus a couple extra ones
Some of those recipes may require the heat of a Blaze Burner
The filter slot can be used in case two recipes are conflicting.

mechanical_piston.title: Moving Structures using Mechanical Pistons
messages: Mechanical Pistons can move blocks in front of them
Speed and direction of movement depend on the Rotational Input
Sticky Mechanical Pistons can pull the attached blocks back

mechanical_piston_modes.title: Movement Modes of the Mechanical Piston
messages: Whenever Pistons stop moving, the moved structure reverts to blocks
It can be configured never to revert to solid blocks, or only at the location it started at

mechanical_plough.title: Using Mechanical Ploughs on Contraptions
messages: Whenever Ploughs are moved as part of an animated Contraption...
...they will break blocks without a solid collision hitbox
Additionally, ploughs can create farmland
...they can also launch entities without hurting them

mechanical_press.title: Processing Items with the Mechanical Press
messages: The Mechanical Press can process items provided beneath it
The Input items can be dropped or placed on a Depot under the Press
When items are provided on a belt...
The Press will hold and process them automatically

mechanical_press_compacting.title: Compacting items with the Mechanical Press
messages: Pressing items held in a Basin will cause them to be Compacted
Compacting includes any filled 2x2 or 3x3 Crafting Recipe, plus a couple extra ones
Some of those recipes may require the heat of a Blaze Burner
The filter slot can be used in case two recipes are conflicting.

mechanical_pump_flow.title: Fluid Transportation using Mechanical Pumps
messages: Mechanical Pumps govern the flow of their attached pipe networks
Their arrow indicates the direction of flow
The network behind is now pulling fluids...
...while the network in front is transferring it outward
The pumps direction is unaffected by the input rotation
Instead, a Wrench can be used to reverse the direction

mechanical_pump_speed.title: Throughput of Mechanical Pumps
messages: Regardless of speed, Mechanical Pumps affect pipes connected up to 16 blocks away
Speeding up the input rotation changes the speed of flow propagation...
...and the speed at which fluids are transferred
Pumps can combine their throughputs within shared pipe networks
Ensure that all of them are facing in the same direction

mechanical_roller_fill.title: Filling terrain with the Roller
messages: While disassembled, rollers can be set to other modes
The 'fill' modes can help to bridge gaps between pavement and terrain
On 'straight fill', they will place simple columns down to the surface
On 'sloped fill', layers placed further down will increase in size
As opposed to 'clear & pave', neither of these modes will cause the rollers to break existing blocks

mechanical_roller_pave.title: Clearing and Paving with the Roller
messages: Mechanical rollers help to clean up terrain around tracks or paths
In its default mode, without a material set, it will simply clear blocks like a Drill
While disassembled, a suitable paving material can be specified
Materials can be supplied via chests or barrels attached to the structure
In addition to breaking blocks, it will now replace the layer beneath them
Note that any block destroyed by a roller has a chance not to yield drops
Rollers are especially useful on Trains, but can also be used on most other types of moving contraptions

mechanical_saw_breaker.title: Cutting Trees with the Mechanical Saw
messages: When given Rotational Force, a Mechanical Saw will cut trees directly in front of it
In order to cut the tree fully, the Saw has to break the last block connecting it to the ground

mechanical_saw_contraption.title: Using Mechanical Saws on Contraptions
messages: Whenever Saws are moved as part of an animated Contraption...
...they will cut any trees the contraption runs them into

mechanical_saw_processing.title: Processing Items on the Mechanical Saw
messages: Upward facing Mechanical Saws can process a variety of items
The processed item always moves against the rotational input to the saw
Saws can work in-line with Mechanical Belts
When an ingredient has multiple possible outcomes, the filter slot can specify it
Without filter, the Saw would cycle through all outcomes instead

millstone.title: Processing Items in the Millstone
messages: Millstones process items by grinding them
They can be powered from the side using cogwheels
Throw or Insert items at the top
After some time, the result can be obtained via Right-click
The outputs can also be extracted by automation

nixie_tube.title: Using Nixie Tubes
messages: When powered by Redstone, Nixie Tubes will display the signal strength
Using written Clipboards, custom text can be displayed
Right-Click with Dye to change their display colour

package_frogport.title: Transporting packages between Frogports
messages: Right-click a Chain Conveyor and place the Frogport nearby
Assign it an address in the inventory UI
If the address of an inserted package does not match it..
Albert
→ Peter
..the Frogport will place the package on the conveyor
Packages spin in place if they have no valid destination
More Frogports can be added anywhere on the chain network
Peter
Packages find their path to a matching frog on the chain network
Peter
→ Peter
Frogports can directly interface with inventories below them
This also works with packagers. Items can be packed and shipped directly
Albert
Peter
Addresses packages to 'Peter'
Right-click Frogports with a clipboard to collect their address
Clipboards with collected names can help auto-complete address inputs in other UIs

packager.title: Creating and unwrapping packages
messages: Attach packagers to the inventory they should target
Given redstone power, it will pack items from the inventory into a package
These can be picked up and transported like any other item
Packages inserted will be destroyed, unpacking the contents into the inventory
Full
Packagers will not accept packages they cannot fully unpack

packager_address.title: Routing packages with an address
messages: Warehouse
When a sign is placed on a packager..
→ Warehouse
Created packages will carry the written lines of text as their address
Package filters route packages based on their address
→ Warehouse
Factory
→ Factory
Factory
For compactness, mechanical saws can unpack straight onto a belt
Aside from filters, Frogports and Postboxes have package routing abilities
Inspect them to find out more about their behaviour

piston_pole.title: Piston Extension Poles
messages: Without attached Poles, a Mechanical Piston cannot move
The Length of pole added at its back determines the Extension Range

portable_fluid_interface.title: Contraption Fluid Exchange
messages: Fluid Tanks on moving contraptions cannot be accessed by any pipes
This component can interact with fluid tanks without the need to stop the contraption
Place a second one with a gap of 1 or 2 blocks inbetween
Whenever they pass by each other, they will engage in a connection
While engaged, the stationary interface will represent ALL Tanks on the contraption
Fluid can now be inserted...
...or extracted from the contraption
After no contents have been exchanged for a while, the contraption will continue on its way

portable_storage_interface.title: Contraption Storage Exchange
messages: Moving inventories can be tricky to access with automation.
This component can interact with storage without the need to stop the contraption.
Place a second one with a gap of 1 or 2 blocks inbetween
Whenever they pass by each other, they will engage in a connection
While engaged, the stationary interface will represent ALL inventories on the contraption
Items can now be inserted...
...or extracted from the contraption
After no items have been exchanged for a while, the contraption will continue on its way

portable_storage_interface_redstone.title: Redstone Control
messages: Redstone power will prevent the stationary interface from engaging

postbox.title: Transporting packages between Postboxes
messages: Right-click a Train Station and place the Postbox nearby
Assign it an address in the inventory UI
If the address of an inserted package does not match it..
Warehouse
→ Outpost
..trains stopping at the station will collect it as cargo
Conversely, packages matching the address will be dropped off
Packages that arrived by train can be extracted from the Postbox
Warehouse
→ Warehouse
Just like trains, Postboxes maintain their behaviour in unloaded chunks
Packages can still be delivered from or to their inventory

powered_latch.title: Controlling signals using the Powered Latch
messages: Powered Latches are redstone controllable Levers
Signals at the back switch it on
Signals from the side switch it back off
Powered latches can also be toggled manually

powered_toggle_latch.title: Controlling signals using the Powered Toggle Latch
messages: Powered Toggle Latches are redstone controllable Levers
Signals at the back will toggle its state
...on and back off
Powered toggle latches can also be toggled manually

pulse_extender.title: Controlling signals using Pulse Extenders
messages: Pulse Extenders can lengthen a signal passing through
They activate after a short delay...
...and cool down for the configured duration
Using the value panel, the discharge time can be configured
The configured duration can range up to an hour

pulse_repeater.title: Controlling signals using Pulse Repeaters
messages: Pulse Repeaters emit a short pulse after a delay
Using the value panel, the charge time can be configured
Configured delays can range up to an hour

radial_chassis.title: Attaching blocks using Radial Chassis
messages: Radial Chassis connect to identical Chassis blocks in a row
When one is moved by a Contraption, the others are dragged with it
The side faces of a Radial Chassis can be made Sticky
Click again to make all other sides sticky
Sneak and Right-Click with an empty hand to remove the slime
Whenever a Block is next to a sticky face...
...it will attach all reachable blocks within a radius on that layer
Using a Wrench, a precise Radius can be specified for this chassis
Blocks not reachable by any sticky face will not attach

redstone_contact.title: Redstone Contacts
messages: Redstone Contacts facing each other will emit a redstone signal
This still applies when one of them is part of a moving Contraption

redstone_link.title: Using Redstone Links
messages: Redstone Links can transmit redstone signals wirelessly
Right-click while Sneaking to toggle receive mode
A simple Right-click with a Wrench can do the same
Receivers emit the redstone power of transmitters within 256 blocks
Placing items in the two slots can specify a Frequency
Only the links with matching Frequencies will communicate

redstone_requester.title: Automated orders with Redstone Requesters
messages: Right-click a Stock link before placement to connect to its network
Just like Stock tickers, Redstone requesters can order items from the logistics network
Right-click the requester to open its configuration UI
The order set in the UI will be requested on every redstone pulse
Alternatively, the requester can be fully configured before placement
Right-click a Stock keeper with it and set the desired order there

repackager.title: Merging packages from a request
messages: Sometimes, it is crucial for logistical requests to arrive as a single package
Order A
Order B
Otherwise, other packages could arrive inbetween
When this is the case, redirect packages to an inventory
Attach a re-packager, and power it with redstone
Once all fragments arrived, they will be exported as a new package
Now, requested items arrive together and in a predictable order

rope_pulley.title: Moving Structures using Rope Pulleys
messages: Rope Pulleys can move blocks vertically when given Rotational Force
Direction and Speed of movement depend on the Rotational Input

rope_pulley_attachment.title: Moving Pulleys as part of a Contraption
messages: Whenever Pulleys are themselves being moved by a Contraption...
...its attached structure will be dragged with it
Mind that pulleys are only movable while stopped

rope_pulley_modes.title: Movement Modes of the Rope Pulley
messages: Whenever Pulleys stop moving, the moved structure reverts to blocks
It can be configured never to revert to solid blocks, or only at the location it started at

rope_pulley_multi_rope.title: Synchronised Pulley Movement
messages: Whenever a pulley assembles a contraption...
...other pulleys on the same layer will connect to the structure
They do not require to be powered, the effect is purely cosmetic

rotation_speed_controller.title: Using the Rotational Speed Controller
messages: Rot. Speed Controllers relay rotation from their axis to a Large Cogwheel above them
Using the value panel on its side, the conveyed speed can be configured

sequenced_gearshift.title: Controlling Rotational Speed using Sequenced Gearshifts
messages: Seq. Gearshifts relay rotation by following a timed list of instructions
Right-click it to open the Configuration UI
Upon receiving a Redstone Signal, it will start running its configured sequence
Once finished, it waits for the next Redstone Signal and starts over
A redstone comparator can be used to read the current progress

shaft.title: Relaying rotational force using Shafts
messages: Shafts will relay rotation in a straight line.

shaft_casing.title: Encasing Shafts
messages: Brass or Andesite Casing can be used to decorate Shafts

smart_chute.title: Filtering Items using Smart Chutes
messages: Smart Chutes are vertical chutes with additional control
Items in the filter slot specify what to extract or transfer
Use the value panel to specify the extracted stack size
Redstone power will prevent Smart Chutes from acting.

smart_observer.title: Advanced detection with Smart Observers
messages: Smart Observers can be used to detect a variety of events
It can detect items or fluids inside of generic containers
The filter slot can be used to look for specific contents only
It also activates when the block itself matches the filter
Additionally, smart observers can monitor belts, chutes and pipes
...and will emit a pulse, if an item enters or exits a funnel

smart_pipe.title: Controlling Fluid flow using Smart Pipes
messages: Smart pipes can help control flows by fluid type
When placed directly at the source, they can specify the type of fluid to extract
Simply Right-Click their filter slot with any item containing the desired fluid
When placed further down a pipe network, smart pipes will only let matching fluids continue

spout_filling.title: Filling Items using a Spout
messages: The Spout can fill fluid holding items provided beneath it
The content of a Spout cannot be accessed manually
Instead, Pipes can be used to supply it with fluids
The Input items can be placed on a Depot under the Spout
When items are provided on a belt...
The Spout will hold and process them automatically

stabilized_bearings.title: Stabilized Contraptions
messages: Whenever Mechanical Bearings are themselves part of a moving Structure..
..they will attempt to keep themselves upright
Once again, the bearing will attach to the block in front of it
As a result, the entire sub-Contraption will stay upright

steam_engine.title: Setting up Steam Engines
messages: Steam Engines can be placed on a Fluid Tank
Clicking the engine with a Shaft creates the Kinetic Output
With sufficient Heat, Water and Boiler space...
...they will generate Rotational Force
The minimal setup requires 4 Fluid Tanks
With the help of Blaze Burners, the power output can be increased
Higher power levels require more Water, Size and Heat
The boiler's current power level can be inspected with Engineer's Goggles
With each added power level, an additional Engine can output at full capacity
Lvl 4
4 Engines
Lvl 8
8 Engines

steam_whistle.title: Setting up Steam Whistles
messages: Steam Whistles can be placed on a Fluid Tank
If the tank receives sufficient heat...
...the Whistle will play a note when activated
Use a Whistle item on the block to lower its pitch
Cycle between three different octaves using a Wrench
Engineer's Goggles can help to find out the current pitch of a Whistle

sticker.title: Attaching blocks using the Sticker
messages: Stickers are ideal for Redstone-controlled block attachment
Upon receiving a signal, it will toggle its state
If it is now moved in a contraption, the block will move with it
Toggled once again, the block is no longer attached

stock_link.title: Logistics Networks and the Stock Link
messages: When placed, Stock Links create a new stock network
Right-click an existing link before placing it to bind them
Stock-linked packagers make their inventory available to the network
Other components on the network can now find and request their items
On request, items from the inventories will be placed into packages
Stock Link signals have unlimited range, but packages require transportation
Full redstone power will stop a link from broadcasting
Analog power lowers the priority of a link, causing others to act first

stock_ticker.title: Ordering items with Stock tickers
messages: Right-click a Stock link before placement to connect to its network
Stock-linked packagers make their attached inventory available to the network
Stock tickers can order items from these inventories
Seated mobs or blaze burners in front of it act as the Stock Keeper
Right-click the keeper to start ordering items
When an order is submitted, the items will be placed into packages
From there, they can be transported to the request point
Using attribute or list filters, categories can be added to the item listings
Right-click the Stock ticker to open the category editor
Stock tickers can also order blocks required for the schematicannon
Simply hand the printed clipboard it generated to the Stock keeper

stock_ticker_address.title: Addressing a Stock ticker order
messages: When ordering items, a target address can be set in the request
→ Workshop
This address will be on all packages created for the request
Using package filters, this can control where the packages will go
→ Workshop
Workshop
→ Factory
→ Factory
Workshop
Aside from filters, Frogports and Postboxes have package routing abilities
Inspect them to find out more about their behaviour

super_glue.title: Attaching blocks using Super Glue
messages: Super Glue groups blocks together into moving contraptions
Clicking two endpoints creates a new 'glued' area
To remove a box, punch it with the glue item in hand
Adjacent blocks sharing an area will pull each other along
Overlapping glue volumes will move together
Blocks hanging on others usually do not require glue

table_cloth.title: Selling items with Table Cloths
messages: Table cloths can be used to display items
With the help of a logistics system, they can also be used to sell items
Start with the shop's inventory, a Packager and Stock link
Bind a Stock ticker to the link and place it in the shop
Employ a mob or blaze burner as the shop keeper
Fill the shop inventory with items to be sold
To create a new trade, interact with the shop keeper while holding a table cloth
Once placed, set a price in the item slot on the side
Other players can now interact with the shop
When checking out at the cashier, the bought items will be placed into a package
From there, they can be transported to the shop front
The payments will be stored inside the stock ticker block

threshold_switch.title: Monitoring with the Threshold Switch
messages: Threshold Switches monitor the fill level of containers
When the inventory content exceeds the upper threshold...
...the switch will change its redstone output
The signal stays until the lower threshold is reached
The redstone output can now be used to control item supply, keeping the buffer filled
The specific thresholds can be changed in the UI
A filter can help to only count specific contents toward the total
Fluid buffers can be monitored in a similar fashion
...as well as, curiously, the length of an extended rope pulley

track_chunks.title: Traversing unloaded Chunks
messages: Tracks stay functional outside of loaded chunks
Trains will travel through inactive sections of the world without issue
They will still stop at stations or red signals
However, Drills and other on-board machines will not operate
Once near a Player, the train will re-appear

track_observer.title: Detecting Trains
messages: Select a Train Track then place the Observer nearby
The Observer will detect any Trains passing over the marker
Observers can be filtered to activate for matching cargo

track_placement.title: Placing Train Tracks
messages: A new type of rail designed for Train Contraptions
To place rows of track in bulk, click on an existing track
Then place or select a second track
Tracks can also be placed as turns or slopes
When connecting, tracks will try to make each turn equally sized
Holding the sprint key while connecting...
...will create the longest fitting bend instead
Materials in the off-hand will be paved under tracks automatically

track_portal.title: Tracks and the Nether
messages: Tracks placed up against a nether portal...
...will attempt to create a paired track on the other side
Trains on this track are now able to travel across dimensions

train_assembly.title: Assembling Trains
messages: Select a Train Track then place the Station nearby
Stations are the Waypoints of your Track Network
To create a new Train, open the UI and switch to Assembly Mode
During Assembly no scheduled trains will approach this station
Create new bogeys by using Train Casing on Tracks
Click the track again to cycle between bogey designs
Attach blocks with the help of Super Glue
Assembled Trains will move faster if they can find fuel in assembled chests or barrels
Fuel stored in Vaults will not be consumed by the train
Every Train requires Train Controls on board
An optional second one allows departure from Stations in both directions
Open the Station UI and confirm the Assembly process
Trains can be disassembled back into blocks at stations only
When used on a station, maps will add a labeled marker at the location
Assembled Trains can be relocated to nearby Tracks using the Wrench

train_controls.title: Controlling Trains
messages: Train Controls are required on every train contraption
Once assembled, right-click the block to start driving
Accelerate and steer the Train using movement keybinds
If desired, the top speed can be fine-tuned using the mouse wheel
Hold space to approach a nearby Station
Trains can only be disassembled back into blocks at Stations
Assembled Whistles can be activated with the sprint key
Sneak or click again to stop controlling the Train

train_schedule.title: Using Train Schedules
messages: Schedules allow Trains to be controlled by other Drivers
Right-click with the item in hand to open its Interface
Once programmed, the Schedule can be handed off to a Train Driver
Any mob or blaze burner sitting in front of Train Controls is an eligible conductor
Creatures on a lead can be given their seat more conveniently
Schedules can be retrieved from Drivers at any moment

train_signal_placement.title: Placing Train Signals
messages: Select a Train Track then place the Signal nearby
Signals control the flow of Trains not driven by players
Scheduled Trains will never cross signals in the opposite direction
...unless a second signal is added facing the opposite way.
Nixie tubes can be attached to make a signal's lights more visible

train_signal_redstone.title: Signals & Redstone
messages: Signals can be forced red by a redstone signal
Conversely, red signals emit a comparator output

train_signal_signaling.title: Collision Prevention with Signals
messages: Train Signals divide a track into segments
If a Segment is occupied, no other Trains will be allowed entry
Thus, each Segment will contain only one Train at a time
A second Signal mode is available via the Wrench
Segments of a brass signal usually lead into standard signals
This special Signal can stop trains under a second condition
It will stop Trains, which, upon entering...
...would not be able to leave the Segment immediately
This helps keeping queued Trains out of a busy Segment

valve_handle.title: Precise rotation using Valve Handles
messages: Valve handles can be used to rotate components by a precise angle
The angle can be configured on the input panel
Right-Click to activate one rotation
Sneak-Right-Click to activate it in the opposite direction
Mind that Bearings have to be specifically told not to disassemble
Valve handles can be dyed for aesthetic purposes

valve_pipe.title: Controlling Fluid flow using Valves
messages: Valve pipes help control fluids propagating through pipe networks
Their shaft input controls whether fluid is currently allowed through
Given Rotational Force in the opening direction, the valve will open up
It can be closed again by reversing the input rotation

water_wheel.title: Generating Rotational Force using Water Wheels
messages: Water Wheels draw force from adjacent Water Currents
Covering additional sides will not improve its kinetic output further
Use wood planks on the wheel to change its appearance

weighted_ejector.title: Using Weighted Ejectors
messages: Sneak and Right-Click holding an Ejector to select its target location
The placed ejector will now launch objects to the marked location
A valid target can be at any height or distance within range
They cannot however be off to a side
If no valid Target was selected, it will simply target the block directly in front
Supply Rotational Force in order to charge it up
Items placed on the ejector cause it to trigger
If Inventories are targeted, the ejector will wait until there is space
Using the value panel, a required Stack Size can be configured
It is now limited to this stack size, and only activates when its held stack reaches this amount
Mobs and Players will always trigger an Ejector when stepping on it

weighted_ejector_redstone.title: Controlling Weighted Ejectors with Redstone
messages: When powered by Redstone, Ejectors will not activate
Observers can detect when Ejectors activate

weighted_ejector_tunnel.title: Splitting item stacks using Weighted Ejectors
messages: Combined with Brass Tunnels, Ejectors can split item stacks by specific amounts
First, configure the Brass Tunnel to 'Prefer Nearest', in order to prioritize its side output
The Stack Size set on the Ejector now determines the amount to be split off
While a new stack of the configured size exits the side output...
...the remainder will continue on its path

windmill_source.title: Generating Rotational Force using Windmill Bearings
messages: Windmill Bearings attach to the block in front of them
Create a movable structure with the help of Super Glue
If enough Sail-like blocks are included, this can act as a Windmill
Activated with Right-Click, the Windmill Bearing will start providing Rotational Force
The Amount of Sail Blocks determine its Rotation Speed
Use the value panel to configure its rotation direction
Right-click the Bearing anytime to stop and edit the Structure again

windmill_structure.title: Windmill Contraptions
messages: Any Structure can count as a valid Windmill, as long as it contains at least 8 sail-like Blocks.
